title: fix(orchestrator): retry upstream HTTP/2 stream resets and GOAWAY

files.patch:
@@ -45,6 +45,11 @@ func TestRetryTransportClassification(t *testing.T) {
 		{"LLM incomplete stream", llm.ErrStreamIncomplete, true},
 		{"orchestrator incomplete stream", ErrStreamIncomplete, true},
 		{"network timeout", &net.DNSError{IsTimeout: true}, true},
+		{"h2 stream error INTERNAL_ERROR", errors.New("failed to stream request: stream error: stream ID 19; INTERNAL_ERROR; received from peer"), true},
+		{"h2 stream error REFUSED_STREAM", fmt.Errorf("read: %w", errors.New("stream error: stream ID 3; REFUSED_STREAM; received from peer")), true},
+		{"h2 GOAWAY", errors.New("http2: server sent GOAWAY and closed the connection; LastStreamID=5, ErrCode=NO_ERROR, debug=\"\""), true},
+		{"h2 stream error with cancellation", errors.Join(context.Canceled, errors.New("stream error: stream ID 19; INTERNAL_ERROR; received from peer")), false},
+		{"h2 stream error with HTTP 400", fmt.Errorf("upstream: %w", &httpclient.Error{StatusCode: http.StatusBadRequest, Body: []byte("stream error: stream ID 1; INTERNAL_ERROR")}), false},
 		{"temporary network error", &net.DNSError{IsTemporary: true}, true},
 		{"wrapped cancellation", fmt.Errorf("read: %w", context.Canceled), false},
 		{"wrapped deadline", &url.Error{Op: "Post", Err: context.DeadlineExceeded}, false},
@@ -116,6 +121,8 @@ func TestRetryTransportPipeline(t *testing.T) {
